CPP11 [MUST] Lifetime-by-design for returned lazy views/generators: never capture a reference parameter, stack local, or temporary *by reference* into a lambda/view/coroutine that outlives the current statement. The returned pipeline must be self-contained: value-capture cheap handles, or own data via value/`shared_ptr` when ownership is shared. "Safe under current join consumption" is not enough — correctness must not depend on an implicit iteration order. Applies to `views::transform`/`filter`/`join`, coroutines, and any deferred callback. Prefer by-value of a small non-owning handle (`TableWithRange`, `TableConstRefWithVocab`, `reference_wrapper`) over `shared_ptr` unless true shared ownership of the *resource* is required; `shared_ptr` of a non-owning handle does not extend the underlying `IdTable`/`LocalVocab` lifetime.
